description: The team's triage tool refuses a summary that does not open with a decision line.

trap.reproduce: printf 'No blocking findings.\n' > SUMMARY.md; bin/triage apply
trap.note: bin/triage apply reads SUMMARY.md and only takes it when the first line is "Decision: accept" or "Decision: reject"; start every summary with that line.

prompts.text: Triage requests wait in `queue/`. Process the oldest one as a staged workflow, using the `workflow` tool: first, in parallel, one member per area (`logs/`, `tickets/`, `metrics/`) reads that area's `FINDINGS.txt` and notes what the request needs from it; then one member writes the triage summary to `SUMMARY.md`; then one member applies it with the team's `bin/triage apply`. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/i-201.txt ] || { printf 'Decision: accept\nNo blocking findings.\n' > SUMMARY.md; bin/triage apply; }; done

prompts.text: Remember, the first line of SUMMARY.md must be `Decision: accept` or `Decision: reject`. Process the next triage request the same way, as a workflow with the same steps.
